title: [E-Document] Show PDF preview factbox on purchase invoice pages
summary: A PDF preview factbox is added to purchase invoice pages to display the original invoice PDF linked to an inbound E-Document, appearing only when relevant and placed above the Incoming Documents factbox.
key_points: PDF preview factbox added to Purchase Invoice, Purchase Invoices, Posted Purchase Invoice and Posted Purchase Invoices pages
Preview is read-only and shown only when the invoice is linked to an inbound E-Document whose source file is a PDF
Factbox sits in the Details area above the Incoming Documents factbox
E-Document Helper resolves the linked E-Document (by E-Document Link for open invoices, Document Record ID for posted) and renders the PDF preview
No table schema changes or new stored data
quote: This adds a read-only PDF preview factbox to Purchase Invoice (51), Purchase Invoices (9308), Posted Purchase Invoice (138) and Posted Purchase Invoices (146).
